name: agent-skills-toolchain
description: Prekzursil's single Claude Code skill surface, generated losslessly from the authoritative .agents/skills tree plus projection-only compatibility routes. Install once instead of copying skills one by one.

plugins.name: agent-skills-toolchain
plugins.description: Entry plugin for the agent-skills-toolchain estate: six skill-estate meta-skills, portable slash commands, and agent definitions. The 400+ skill longtail stays in the repo trees, discovered via skill-scout instead of flooding the skill listing.
